name: tree
title: Tree View
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.pxxl.click>
description: Recursive hierarchical data display with full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End), animated expand/collapse, multi-select, and optional connecting lines.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/tree. Pass nodes to TreeRoot. Keyboard navigation works automatically when the tree container is focused. Use config.multiSelect for multi-select and config.showLines for connecting lines.
